$comment: Registered historic wildfire events replayed from the NASA FIRMS standard-processing archive. The /api/fire-history proxy only fetches events listed here — never client-supplied dates or boxes. bbox is [west, south, east, north] in degrees; dates are inclusive UTC days. `perimeter` (optional) names a whitelisted NIFC ArcGIS service and structured filters; the proxy builds the query itself and keeps the largest matching polygon as the event's final perimeter.

events.name: Camp Fire
events.summary: Ignited near Pulga on 8 November 2018 and destroyed the town of Paradise within hours. Declared contained on 25 November 2018.

events.name: Lahaina Fire
events.summary: Wind-driven fire that reached the town of Lahaina on 8 August 2023 during Hurricane Dora's passage south of the islands.

events.name: Park Fire
events.region: Butte and Tehama Counties, California, USA
events.summary: Started in Bidwell Park near Chico on 24 July 2024 and grew into the fourth-largest wildfire in California's recorded history.
